Subject:- Activation
of UAN and KYCseeding- regarding.
Reference: This office circulars of even number:-
i.
Dated 31-12-2015 (at serial number 586; Office Circulars dated 2015-16)
ii.
Dated 23-12-2015 (at serial number 586; Office Circulars dated 2015-16)
Sir,
The issue of activation of UAN has been reviewed and following directions are being issued:-
a}
KYCseeding and UAN activation for all currently contributing
members is to be ensured.
b}
In
case of
all
such
UANs issued
where
no
activation
and/or
no/incomplete
digitally
authenticated
KYCis available and where no contribution
is being received, date of exit in all
such cases must invariably be captured and uploaded.
cl
On the
MI5 portal
a dashboard
of currently
contributing
members,
their
UAN allotment,
activation and KYCseeding status is available. Offices must use the dashboard to monitor the
progress.
d}
This dashboard is updated on a daily basis. On 20th of every month the "due month" status is
changed. The dashboard as on 21-01-2016 contains data of "due month" December 2015 paid in
January 2016. On 20th February 2016 the "due month" will change to "due mo~th" January 2016
paid in February 2016.
e}
Perusal of the data as on 21-01-2016 shows that :-
i}
1.591ac establishments
have remitted
dues in respect of 1.68 crore members. It indicates
that either dues are not being remitted on time or the reconciliation
of remitted
dues with
ECRis not taking place in timely manner. Offices may ensure that this aspect is watched
closely and timely action is taken.
ii}
Of the contributing
members, 30.72 lac (18.32%) are yet to be allotted
UAN. This task is
pending on the part of establishments
as they have to either
provide the UAN of these
members or declare that they are members joining the scheme for the first time. This must
be expedited.
iii}
40% of allotted UAN is not yet activated .
. (iv)
Aadhaar & PAN is available in case of 29% of contributing
members to whom
UAN is
allotted.

(v) Bank account details are available in case of only 56% of contributing
members. This is a
mandatory
activity and it must be ensured that bank account details are furnished by all
contributing
members.
2.
Offices may devise their own strategy for ensuring activation
and KYC seeding. However, it
would be a good idea focus on top 20% establishments in terms of UAN issued as they would account
for 75-80% of UAN issued.
3.
A dashboard is likely to be made available soon of such UANs where no contribution
is being
received and in whose case no "date of exit" is available on record for the assistance of EPFOoffices.
Yours faithfully,
~C--
